symbols.title: US Stock Tickers (Mag 7 by default)
symbols.description: List of stock symbols to analyze. Magnificent Seven (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META, TSLA) are pre-configured by default. You can add or replace with any US stock ticker (e.g. AMD, PLTR, NFLX, COIN, SMCI, BABA).

includePeerComparison.title: Include Magnificent 7 Valuation Benchmark
includePeerComparison.description: Include side-by-side valuation multiples (P/E, Forward P/E, PEG, EV/EBITDA) against the Mag 7 peer group.

quartersBack.title: Historical Earnings Quarters to Analyze
quartersBack.description: Number of previous earnings quarters to evaluate for gap-fill probability, beat rates, and 5-day drift.
